subject: Shaw's Site Development Project
overview: The Medford City Council reviewed a proposed 490-unit development at the Shaw's site on Locust Street and voted to request that the Zoning Board of Appeals delay rendering a decision pending an open public hearing. The Council also addressed local business licenses, street maintenance resolutions, water billing accountability, and tabled a proposed community electricity aggregation plan.

items.title: Claim Settlement - Mark Hennessey
items.summary: The Council approved a $3,400 settlement for property damage resulting from an accident involving a DPW vehicle.

items.title: Common Victualler License - 7-Eleven Inc.
items.summary: The Council approved a common victualler license for 7-Eleven Inc. at 133 Main Street, noting the city clerk would advise the petitioner if a special permit is required for 24-hour operation.

items.title: Common Victualler License - Soda Barbecue Inc.
items.summary: The license application for Soda Barbecue Inc. at 27 Riverside Avenue was tabled because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: City Budget Submission
items.summary: The Council tabled the formal submission of the fiscal year city budget until budget review hearings are complete.

items.title: Resolution on Route 60 and City Hall Mall Road Lane Markings
items.summary: The Council approved an amended resolution requesting the DPW repaint faded lane markings on Route 60 West, City Hall Mall Road, and surrounding square intersections.

items.title: Class 2 Auto Dealer License - A-Tech
items.summary: The Council approved a Class 2 auto dealer license for A-Tech at 67 Mystic Street, subject to a limit of 12 vehicle spaces and a six-month review.

items.title: Resolution on Pedestrian Safety
items.summary: The Council voted to table a resolution regarding pedestrian safety until the following meeting.

items.title: Zoning Decision Delay Request for Shaw's Site Development
items.summary: Following extensive testimony from residents opposing the size, traffic impact, and parking reductions of a proposed 490-unit development on Locust Street, the Council approved an amended resolution asking the Zoning Board of Appeals to delay filing its written decision until after an open public hearing.

items.title: Water and Sewer Line Item in Operating Budgets
items.summary: The Council approved an amended resolution requesting that municipal and school operating budgets include explicit line items for water and sewer expenses rather than passing unmetered costs to ratepayers, while also requesting a status update on citywide leak detection.

items.title: Community Electricity Aggregation Authorization
items.summary: The Council tabled a resolution to authorize community electricity aggregation after hearing a presentation from the Office of Energy and Environment and public comments regarding opt-out requirements.

items.title: Resolutions on Utility Patching Materials and Hours
items.summary: The Council approved resolutions requesting reports from the DPW Director and City Engineer regarding approved patching materials and operating hour restrictions for utility street work following late-night paving on Butler Street.

items.title: Resolution on Trimming Grass at Webster and Fountain Streets
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting the Mayor ask state transportation officials to trim overgrown grass obstructing driver sightlines at Webster and Fountain Streets.

items.title: Commendation for Medford High School Crew Team
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution commending the Medford High School crew team for earning a silver medal at the State Rowing Championship and inviting them to receive citations.

items.title: Pothole Repair on St. James Road
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting DPW repair potholes on St. James Road.
